> [!CAUTION]
> **DO NOT SUBMIT PUBLIC GITHUB ISSUES FOR SECURITY VULNERABILITIES**
> Public issues expose vulnerabilities before patches can be made available to users.

### How to Report Security Vulnerabilities Confidentially

1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting (Preferred)**:
   Navigate to the **Security** tab of this repository, select **Advisories**, and click **"Report a vulnerability"**.

2. **Direct Maintainer Email**:
   Email the project maintainers directly at:
   **niranjansah250@gmail.com**

Please refer to our **[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md)** for our full disclosure policy, response SLA, and encryption guidelines.
